description: Prepare and gate one reviewed direct-router swap for an AI agent on Base or BNB Smart Chain: Aerodrome Slipstream WETH→USDC CL100 and USDC→USDT CL1 (both directions) on Base, PancakeSwap V3 USDC→USDT 0.01% on Base, or PancakeSwap V3 USDT→USDC 0.01% on BNB (both directions). It obtains a fresh pinned quote, re-verifies reviewed contract identities, canonical-decodes the exact approval/swap calldata, validates both agent decision prices against independent oracle consensus, and converts the route quote using the independent destination consensus before applying price-impact/TWAP/slippage/freshness policy. ALLOW returns exact unsigned approval and swap calldata plus a decisionHash, and adds a short-lived signed decision when Insight has a published attester; CAUTION or BLOCK returns no calls to sign. After settlement, pair the signed decision with the swap transaction hash via settle_base_agent_swap_guard to obtain a signed settlement closure. It does not route, sign, relay, broadcast, authorize, assess smart-account UserOperations, or accept arbitrary aggregator calldata.
name: prepare_base_agent_swap_guard
